models.notes: Initial heuristic model for legacy feature input.
Aggregate-aware heuristic model. Still used automatically as the live fallback for routes without enough history for the seasonal model (see docs/forecasting.md).

Additive Holt-Winters seasonal forecaster, evaluated MAE=28.63 RMSE=41.43 MAPE=12.15% on the synthetic held-out set (see docs/forecasting.md), roughly halving baseline-v2-aggregate's error. Falls back to baseline-v2-aggregate per-route until 2 full seasons (48h) of history accumulate.
